children: Expectations of more interest rate increases by the Reserve Bank of Australia have cooled amid signs that the economy is slowing. Still, the central bank has an ongoing inflation problem. Trimmed mean inflation in 3Q printed at a solid 3.7% on-year, with market services inflation recording its strongest annual growth since 2024, says Siddhant Kalra, an economist at ANZ. Given the links between market services inflation and domestic capacity pressures, the strong result will keep the RBA cautious in the coming months, he adds. (james.glynn@wsj.com; @JamesGlynnWSJ)
